nodes.description: CultCult._transfer internal override: applies anti-whale limits, tx.origin per-block delay, fee-on-transfer logic, triggers swapBack and autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens
swapBack private: swaps accumulated tokens for ETH and distributes ETH to dev and marketing wallets via low-level calls
swapTokensForEth private: approves router and swaps tokens for ETH supporting fee-on-transfer tokens
addLiquidity private: approves router and adds ETH/token liquidity, sending LP to dead address
startTrading onlyOwner: enables trading and swap and records lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens internal: burns a percentage of the LP pair balance to dead address and calls pair.sync()
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens onlyOwner: owner-triggered LP burn with cooldown, transfers pair tokens to dead and calls sync()
updateSwapTokensAtAmount onlyOwner: bounds-checked update of swapTokensAtAmount threshold
updateMaxTxnAmount onlyOwner: updates maxTransactionAmount with minimum bound check
updateMaxWalletAmount onlyOwner: updates maxWallet with minimum bound check
setAutoLPBurnSettings onlyOwner: sets LP burn frequency, percent and enabled flag
excludeFromFees onlyOwner: toggles fee exemption for an account
excludeFromMaxTransaction onlyOwner: toggles max transaction/wallet exemption for an address
updateMarketingWallet onlyOwner: changes marketing wallet receiving ETH from swapBack
updateDevWallet onlyOwner: changes dev wallet receiving ETH from swapBack
updateSwapEnabled onlyOwner: toggles automatic contract-token swapping
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair onlyOwner: registers an AMM pair, cannot remove the main pair
removeLimits onlyOwner: disables all transfer limits permanently
disableTransferDelay onlyOwner: disables the per-block transfer delay permanently
isExcludedFromFees view: returns fee exemption status for an account
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair private: writes automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping and emits event
CultCult constructor: deploys pair, sets fee/max parameters and mints total supply to msg.sender
bool swapping guard preventing recursive swap/fee logic during token transfers
bool tradingActive gate for transfers before launch
bool swapEnabled controls automatic token-to-ETH swapping
bool limitsInEffect toggles anti-whale and transfer-delay checks
bool transferDelayEnabled toggles one-purchase-per-block restriction
uint256 lastLpBurnTime timestamp of last automatic LP burn
mapping(address=>uint256) _holderLastTransferTimestamp per-origin last block used for transfer delay
address marketingWallet receives ETH from swapBack
address devWallet receives ETH from swapBack
uint256 tokensForLiquidity accumulated liquidity fee tokens
uint256 tokensForMarketing accumulated marketing fee tokens
uint256 tokensForDev accumulated dev fee tokens
uint256 maxTransactionAmount anti-whale per-transaction cap
uint256 maxWallet anti-whale per-wallet cap
uint256 swapTokensAtAmount threshold triggering swapBack
uint256 percentForLPBurn basis points burned from LP each auto burn
uint256 lpBurnFrequency seconds between automatic LP burns
bool lpBurnEnabled toggles automatic LP burning
uint256 lastManualLpBurnTime timestamp of last manual LP burn
uint256 manualBurnFrequency cooldown for manual LP burns
mapping(address=>bool) automatedMarketMakerPairs registered AMM pair addresses
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFees fee exemption list
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount max cap exemption list
address uniswapV2Pair LP pair address used for burns and sync
IUniswapV2Router02 immutable uniswapV2Router used for swaps and liquidity
msg.sender externally controlled caller address
block.timestamp miner-influenced time value used for burns, deadlines and launch timing
tx.origin used as key for the one-purchase-per-block transfer delay mapping
low-level call transferring ETH to devWallet inside swapBack before final balance distribution
low-level call sending the entire contract ETH balance to marketingWallet inside swapBack
external call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with 0 minimum output
external payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH with zero slippage minimums
external call to IUniswapV2Pair.sync() after burning LP tokens
address from parameter of _transfer
address to parameter of _transfer
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer
uint256 percent parameter of manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens
uint256 newAmount parameter of updateSwapTokensAtAmount
uint256 tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth
uint256 contractTokenBalance local in _transfer computed from balanceOf(address(this))
uint256 fees local in _transfer holding computed fee amount
uint256 amountToBurn local computed from pair balance and percentForLPBurn
uint256 ethForDev local ETH share forwarded to devWallet
uint256 ethForMarketing local ETH share forwarded to marketingWallet
uint256 ethForLiquidity local ETH remainder used for addLiquidity

edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the key of _holderLastTransferTimestamp inside _transfer, making the anti-bot delay dependent on an untrusted origin value
block.timestamp and block.number drive the LP burn trigger and transfer delay checks in _transfer, making behavior miner-influenced
startTrading stores block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime, making the LP burn schedule dependent on miner-controlled time
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens resets lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp to gate future burns
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens compares and stores block.timestamp against the manual burn cooldown
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in addLiquidity
constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender, an externally controlled address
_transfer reads and writes the swapping reentrancy guard around swapBack
_transfer reads tradingActive to gate early transfers
_transfer reads transferDelayEnabled to apply the per-block purchase limit
_transfer compares and writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp keyed by tx.origin
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to determine buy/sell fee and limit paths
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee and trading gates
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount to bypass max amount checks
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buy and sell
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipient balances
_transfer compares contract balance with swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swapBack
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity using mul/div fee share arithmetic
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing using mul/div fee share arithmetic
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev using mul/div fee share arithmetic
swapBack reads marketingWallet and forwards it the remaining contract ETH via low-level call
swapBack reads devWallet and forwards ETH before the marketing transfer and final state settlement
swapBack uses tokensForLiquidity to size the liquidity portion and then zeroes it
swapBack uses tokensForMarketing to compute the marketing ETH share
swapBack uses tokensForDev to compute the dev ETH share
swapTokensForEth approves and calls the uniswapV2Router for the token to ETH swap
addLiquidity approves and calls the uniswapV2Router to add ETH liquidity
startTrading sets tradingActive to true
startTrading sets swapEnabled to true
startTrading initializes lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens overwrites lastLpBurnTime with block.timestamp
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens computes burn amount via mul/div with percentForLPBurn
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads uniswapV2Pair balance and syncs the pair
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads and writes lastManualLpBurnTime for the cooldown check
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens compares block.timestamp against lastManualLpBurnTime plus manualBurnFrequency
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads uniswapV2Pair balance and syncs the pair
updateSwapTokensAtAmount bounds the new value with totalSupply mul/div and writes swapTokensAtAmount
updateMaxTxnAmount scales the new value by 10**18 and writes maxTransactionAmount
updateMaxWalletAmount scales the new value by 10**18 and writes maxWallet
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees privileged exemption mapping
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount privileged exemption mapping
updateMarketingWallet overwrites the ETH payout address used by swapBack
updateDevWallet overwrites the ETH payout address used by swapBack
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair routes through _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair to write AMM pair flags
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping
_transfer calls swapBack while holding the swapping guard, and swapBack performs external ETH transfers based on pool state
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens which makes an external pair.sync() call during a user transfer
swapBack invokes swapTokensForEth, an external router interaction, before distributing ETH
swapBack invokes addLiquidity, an external payable router interaction
swapBack performs a low-level call sending ETH to devWallet before clearing fee accounting and finishing payouts
swapBack performs a final low-level call forwarding the whole contract ETH balance to marketingWallet
swapTokensForEth calls the external router swap with zero minimum output, an external call reachable during transfers
addLiquidity calls the external router addLiquidityETH with zero slippage minimums
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() externally after transferring pair tokens to the dead address
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() externally after burning LP tokens

normalization_plan.reason: address from is only meaningful as the source argument of _transfer and should be folded into that core function node
address to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of _transfer and should be folded into that core function node
uint256 amount is only meaningful as the value argument of _transfer and its fee arithmetic
uint256 percent is only used to compute the burn size inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens
uint256 newAmount is only used to validate and assign swapTokensAtAmount in updateSwapTokensAtAmount
uint256 tokenAmount is only used as the swap input in swapTokensForEth
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed from balanceOf(address(this)) to decide whether to call swapBack inside _transfer
fees is a temporary fee amount computed and consumed only within _transfer
amountToBurn is computed from percentForLPBurn solely to perform the burn inside autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens
ethForDev is derived from the ETH balance and forwarded to devWallet exclusively inside swapBack
ethForMarketing is derived from the ETH balance and used exclusively inside swapBack allocation logic
ethForLiquidity is the computed remainder passed to addLiquidity exclusively inside swapBack
